generation_prompt: The robot closes its right hand around the Rubik's cube on the bottom wooden shelf and lifts it clear. It raises the cube to the top wooden shelf, lowers it toward the surface, and begins opening its fingers while the hand remains around the cube. Keep the camera fixed; preserve robot geometry, physically valid joint motion, and normal gripper opening and closing.
observed_terminal_state: Cube is at the highest wooden shelf with right fingers beginning to open. The hand remains around the cube; the lower contact area is occluded by the hand and no fully withdrawn hand or unambiguously independent resting cube is shown. Lowest tray is empty and left hand remains idle.

arm_hand_roles.right: Sole manipulating hand: closes fingers around cube, lifts from bottom tray, transports to highest shelf, lowers and starts opening fingers.
arm_hand_roles.left: Open and idle throughout; no cube contact, stabilization or transfer.

uncertainties: At the ending, the right hand occludes the cube's lower surface and shelf contact. Full release and independent stable support by the top shelf are not established.

data_quality_gate.rule: Variance of the Laplacian of the luma of the model-view frame (cover-resize to the nearest-aspect 720p-class bucket, center crop); pass if >= 120 third-person, >= 60 first-person.
